name: minPerDay
label: Posts Per Day
help: 1 to 20, and not more than the number of posting times.

name: group
label: Channel Group
help: Every post goes to every account in the group. Or map explicit accounts below.

name: socialAccountIds
label: Social Accounts
help: Used instead of the group when set.

name: postIds
label: Post IDs
help: Specific drafts, in the order to place them. Leave empty to schedule every draft, oldest first.

name: startDate
label: Start Date
help: First day to place posts on. Defaults to tomorrow.

name: times
label: Posting Times
help: Wall-clock times in the workspace timezone, overriding the workspace defaults for this run.

name: dryRun
label: Dry Run
help: Return the plan without creating any timers.
